segments.name: Astrotech Corporation
segments.description: Develops and commercializes mass spectrometry and gas chromatography analytical instruments for security, agriculture, breath analysis, industrial process control, and environmental testing applications.
segments.evidence: Our use of "products" and "devices" refer to the TRACER 1000™, BreathTest-1000™, AGLAB 1000™, and Pro-Control 1000™ along with related accessories and consumables.

revenueModel.text: Customers in United States and foreign countries purchase products, services, and receive grants for technology development and deployment across security, agriculture, healthcare, and industrial sectors.
